blocks.html: Johnson Bath Division manufactures faucets at two facilities in Baddi & Samba with a combined capacity of 1.6 million pieces per annum. Guided by the core concept of "Adorability, Adaptability & Affordability", Johnson offers 12 distinct faucet series from affordable ISI-certified lines to premium Elite concealed mixers that save up to 40% water. From pillar cocks to sophisticated sensor taps.

items: ISI Certified range — quality assurance across affordable series
Elite range — ultra-modern concealed body mixers using up to 40% less water
Highly durable cartridges — extended service life
In-house R&D and testing facilities at Baddi & Samba plants
Sensor taps — touchless operation for superior hygiene
Pressmatic taps — self-closing, water-saving in high-traffic areas
Complete range from pillar cocks to concealed diverters and mixers
Kitchen sink mixers and health faucets also available
Hospitals and healthcare — sensor taps for hygiene
Public washrooms — pressmatic taps for water conservation

items.name: Products Available in Each Series
items.std: Pillar cocks, mixers, diverters, showers & accessories

intro.html: Johnson offers 12 complete bathroom faucet series, each with a coordinated range of pillar cocks, mixers, diverters and accessories:

items.name: Kitchen Faucets
items.std: Kitchen sink mixers & pillar cocks — Quebec, Fast, New Comfort, Smile series

items.name: Sensor Taps
items.std: Touchless operation — superior hygiene for high-traffic areas

blocks.html: Infrared sensor taps for touchless water activation. Ideal for hospitals, hotels, offices and public washrooms. Prevents cross-contamination and reduces water waste through automatic cut-off.

items.name: Pressmatic Taps
items.std: Self-closing water-saving taps for public/commercial use

blocks.html: Self-closing push-button taps that automatically shut off after a set time. Highly water-efficient — ideal for schools, offices, bus stands, hospitals and other public washrooms.

Johnson offers a comprehensive range of ceramic sanitaryware including closets, basins, urinals and allied products. Available in three ranges — Johnson (standard), Johnson International (premium, rimless 360° flush technology) and Germ-Free (anti-bacterial glaze). Dual flush systems, soft-close seat covers and wall-hung options for every project type.

items: Rimless Cistern with 360° flush technology — superior hygiene, no hidden surfaces
Germ-Free Glaze — special anti-bacterial coating prevents bacterial growth
Syphonic flushing — efficiently cleans entire bowl using less water
Dual Flush — 3-litre & 6-litre options to conserve water
Soft-Close Detachable Seat Covers — reduces noise, easy cleaning
Johnson International range — international quality with fully concealed installation
Smooth, non-porous ceramic surfaces — resist dirt, stains and bacteria
Available in Omni Suite (complete matched sets) for coordinated bathroom design
Residential bathrooms — all types from affordable to luxury
Hotels and hospitality — Germ-Free range preferred

blocks.html: Complete bathroom suite sets with matching closet and basin in a coordinated design. Includes Germ-Free Omni Suites with anti-bacterial glaze. Available with S-Trap and P-Trap configurations (300mm / 400mm).

items.name: Floor Mounted Coupled Closets
items.std: Cistern connected to back of bowl | Standard & Germ-Free

blocks.html: Traditional floor-mounted WC with cistern attached at rear. Available with dual flush (3L/6L), syphonic action and Germ-Free glaze. S-Trap and P-Trap variants available.
Wall-hung pan with cistern mounted above. Saves floor space, easier to clean floor beneath. Modern aesthetic suitable for compact bathrooms.

items.name: Wall Hung Closets (with Concealed Cistern)
items.std: Johnson International range | Fully concealed system

blocks.html: Premium wall-hung WC with concealed in-wall cistern system. Johnson International range features rimless 360° flush technology for maximum hygiene. Fully concealed installation — sleek, modern finish.
In-wall concealed flush cisterns for wall-hung WC systems. Dual flush mechanism, access panel for maintenance, compatible with all Johnson wall-hung WC models.

items.name: EWCs, Orissa Pans & Exposed Flush Tanks

blocks.html: EWC (European Water Closet) pans in various designs, Orissa Pans (Indian-style squatting WC) and exposed flush tanks for traditional plumbing setups.

Vanity basins available for countertop (over-counter) and under-counter installation. Various shapes — rectangular, oval and round. E.g. "Creta" countertop basin: 415×415×135mm. Modern slim designs with Germ-Free glaze available.

items.name: Wash Basins (Pedestal & Wall-Hung)
items.std: With or without pedestal | Various sizes

blocks.html: Classic pedestal washbasins (full and half pedestal), wall-hung basins for space saving. Multiple sizes for different bathroom dimensions. Germ-Free glaze available across models.
Wall-mounted urinals with flushing systems and ceramic/opaque partitions. For commercial buildings, offices, hotels, schools and public washrooms. Germ-Free glaze available.

items.name: Allied Sanitaryware Products
items.std: Flush valves, bottle traps, waste couplings

blocks.html: Toilet seat covers available in standard and soft-close (slow-close) types. Detachable for easy cleaning and maintenance. PP (polypropylene) and duroplast (urea formaldehyde) materials. Fits all Johnson WC models.

Johnson offers a comprehensive shower range from simple overhead showers to elaborate multi-function shower systems and enclosures. The flagship 4-in-1 Concealed Body Shower combines overhead, hand, back and body jets in one system. Shower enclosures available in sliding, hinged and walk-in configurations. Health faucets and shower arms complete the range.

items: 4-in-1 Concealed Body Shower — overhead + hand + back jets + body jets in one system
Rain shower heads — multiple spray patterns and sizes
Shower enclosures — sliding, hinged and walk-in configurations (tempered glass)
Shower panels — multiple body jets, hand shower and overhead in one unit
Diverters for routing water between different outlets
Health faucets (Fantasia and other series) with 1 metre CP hose and hook
Shower arms in various lengths and angles

blocks.html: Fixed overhead shower heads in round and square formats. Multiple sizes: 200mm, 250mm, 300mm+ diameter. Various spray modes — rain, jet, mist. Available with anti-limescale rubber nozzles.
Hand-held shower units with 1.5 metre flexible stainless steel hose and wall bracket. Multiple spray modes available. Compatible with all Johnson shower mixers.

items.name: 4-in-1 Concealed Body Shower
items.std: Premium multi-function system — overhead + hand + body jets

blocks.html: Complete in-wall concealed shower system combining: (1) Rain overhead shower, (2) Hand shower, (3) Side body jets, (4) Back massage jets. Single concealed body with thermostatic or pressure-balanced valve. Fully concealed pipework for clean aesthetic.

items.name: Shower Panels
items.std: Multi-function tower panel with body jets

blocks.html: Freestanding or wall-mounted shower panels with multiple body jets, overhead rain shower and hand shower in one unit. Stainless steel or ABS finish.

items.name: Multi-Function Shower Enclosures
items.std: With integrated body jets and steam

blocks.html: Premium enclosed shower cubicles with integrated multi-function features — body jets, rain shower, hand shower, steam generator. Frameless tempered glass, chrome fittings.
Tempered safety glass, aluminium frames in chrome/brushed finishes. Shower trays available in acrylic and stone resin.

items.name: Free Standing Bath Tub Fillers & Multi-Function Bath Tubs

blocks.html: Free-standing bath tub filler taps and multi-function bath tubs with integrated jets and overflow filler. Designed to work with the wellness bathtub range.

items.name: Allied Shower Products
items.std: Health faucets, shower arms, diverters & more

blocks.html: Johnson offers kitchen sinks for residential, commercial and public kitchens. The range covers single and double bowl sinks in stainless steel and composite/quartz materials, in under-counter, countertop and drop-in mounting options. Multiple size and bowl configuration options to suit every kitchen layout.

items: Stainless steel sinks — 304 grade, satin/matt finish options
Quartz / composite sinks — scratch and stain resistant, heat resistant to 280°C
Single bowl, double bowl and 1.5 bowl configurations
Complete with drainage accessories and waste fittings
Lab sinks also available for institutional use
Residential kitchens — home renovations and new builds

blocks.html: Available in satin finish (brushed) and mirror finish. Under-counter, countertop and drop-in mounting options. Comes with drainage accessories.

Granite/quartz composite sinks — scratch resistant, heat resistant up to 280°C, food-safe, low maintenance. Available in multiple colours including black, grey and beige. Single and double bowl options.

Johnson's wellness range brings luxury bathing experiences to Indian homes. The range includes free-standing bathtubs, built-in soaking tubs, whirlpool/jacuzzi-style tubs with water jets, steam bath units and shower enclosures with spa features. Designed for residential luxury bathrooms, premium hotels and wellness spas.

items: Free-standing bathtubs — contemporary sculptural designs in acrylic
Multi-function bathtubs — integrated whirlpool jets, air massage, chromotherapy lighting
Built-in bathtubs — alcove and drop-in installation for fitted bathrooms
Bath tub fillers — floor-mounted and wall-mounted spout options
Steam bath units — for shower enclosures and custom steam rooms
Luxury residential bathrooms and master ensuites

blocks.html: Freestanding acrylic bathtubs in oval, rectangular and slipper (single-ended) designs. Floor-mounted filler compatible. Sizes typically 1500mm, 1600mm, 1700mm length.
Luxury bathtubs with integrated water jets (whirlpool), air massage system, LED chromotherapy lighting and digital controls. Acrylic reinforced with fibreglass. Alcove and drop-in configurations.
Dedicated bathtub filler taps — floor-mounted roman tub fillers, wall-mounted bath spouts with hand shower. Available in chrome and brushed nickel finishes.

items.name: Multi-Function Shower Enclosures
items.std: With steam, body jets & LED lighting

blocks.html: Complete shower cabins with: overhead rain shower, hand shower, body jets, steam generator, LED chromotherapy lighting, FM radio and Bluetooth speaker in top-end models. Tempered glass, aluminium frame.

Johnson offers a complete range of bathroom accessories to complement every faucet and sanitaryware series. Towel rails, rings, soap dishes, tumbler holders, robe hooks, paper holders, glass shelves and bathroom cabinets — all coordinated to match Johnson's faucet design series. Available in chrome, brushed and stainless steel finishes.

items: Coordinated designs — accessories match corresponding faucet series
Available in chrome, brushed nickel and stainless steel finishes
Rust-resistant materials for long life in humid bathroom environments
Bathroom mirrors — standard and LED-backlit options
Bathroom cabinets — mirror cabinets with storage
Residential bathrooms — complete the bathroom set
Hotels and hospitality — branded bathroom accessory sets

items.name: Bathroom Accessories — Complete Range
items.std: Chrome, brushed & SS finishes | All series

blocks.html: Wall-mounted bathroom mirrors in standard (framed and frameless) and LED backlit versions. Various sizes and shapes — rectangular, oval and round. Anti-fog available on premium models.
Wall-mounted mirror cabinets with internal shelves for storing toiletries and medicines. Single and double door options. Stainless steel or aluminium frame construction.
